title: Is Demand Gen Worth It? (Google Ads)
description: Is Demand Gen Worth It? (Google Ads)
transcript: Should more advertisers be using Demand Gen? I think Demand Gen was set up specifically for advertisers coming from another ad platform. So let's say you run meta ads, you want to give Google a go, diversify your advertising efforts. Demand Gen is perfect for that. So I'd say yes, more Google advertisers should be using Demand Gen because more other social advertisers should be running campaigns on Google as well, diversifying your ad efforts. Another place to reach a lot of people. And Demand Gen makes it really easy cause you can take the creative assets you've already produced for other places and stick them straight into Demand Gen campaign and you're good to go.
